system.description: Spend 3 Hope when a creature within Close range would mark their last unmarked Hit Point or make a Death Move. They don’t take the consequences of the Death Move and remain alive and conscious, clearing 1 Hit Point instead, but becoming temporarily Vulnerable until they receive medical attention or the scene ends.
